result:
Sitting at the edge of the grassy cliff, Sarah looked out into the crisp Pacific Ocean, her legs swaying lightly in the sea breeze; a gentle reminder of the world’s romance with movement. The world was aglow as the sun gradually started descending on the horizon, painting the playful sky into tones of orange, pink, and deep purple. This spontaneous battle of warm and cool hues always soothed her. She had merely the infinity of the sky, the vastness of the ocean and the strength of the cliffs for company, and in that moment, she wouldn't want it any other way.

She relished these quiet moments of solitude. There was something poetically lonely about existing on this little blue dot in the midst of an endlessly expanding universe. To some people, that idea could be terrifying, resonating with an existential crisis, but for Sarah, it was comforting. It served as a sobering reminder that the universe was grand and we, against its cosmic canvas, were just myriad stardust brought together for a moment in time.

A small seashell lay next to her, a masterpiece crafted by nature, every spiral and line a testament to life itself. As she held it against her ear, a tradition she had held since she was a little girl, she smiled upon hearing the echo of the sea, a sound promising adventure. A wandering serenade that captured the essence of her restless spirit, beckoning her to venture into the unknown, to explore and dive into life’s boundless possibilities.

Sarah had always felt a profound connection with the ocean. The ocean, with its vast expanse and changing moods, was a perfect mirror of her soul. Its roaring waves as wild as her dreams. Its tranquil stillness akin to her peaceful solitude. Its depths as mysterious as her thoughts. And in its constant ebb and flow, she found an unusual harmony, teaching her the eternal truth of nature – that life was not merely about sustaining the highs, but also gracefully embracing the lows.

She often romanticised life as a series of limitless wanderings. Wanderings into the unknown terrains of life, sometimes blatantly adventurous, sometimes quietly introspective. And through these wanderings, she sought to lose herself, only to discover a newer self – shaping and reshaping herself on the anvil of experiences.

The sun had now retired beyond the horizon, leaving behind a star-studded sky, a nocturnal sonnet unfolded. Ancient light traveling across the cosmos, reaching her eyes – another cosmic connection felt. Her heart resonating with gentle gratitude, she soaked in this moment, creating a safe transient home in time.

Miles away from the noise of the city, free from the superficialities of society, here on this secluded cliff, she had built a special connection with the cosmos. She was a solitary explorer finding her place in an awe-inspiring cosmic drama. Her existence might constitute a tiny fraction in the universe, but in her heart, she carried an entire cosmos, a beautifully chaotic swirl of dreams, love, mysteries, and endless journeys.

With the starlight guiding her spirit, she sat still, carving her thoughts into the heart of the world. Understanding with each passing moment, that embracing our smallness could sometimes be the grandest thing one could do. Her only friends, the stars, glistening like lyrics of a forgotten lullaby, lulled her into dreaming new dreams. And she knew, under this expansive sky, she would continue to live, etching her story onto the canvas of life – a cosmic story in the grand universe ballet.
